{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","hash":"19d7dd220a4c2b867c5caa868b7e0d511c746fa9c0d8573103e6b878889b72dc","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XDGwPZuukyJ6csQWXxgPYc","type":"tool_result","content":"## Implementation Decisions\n\n**Modules**\n\n- **Accounts.** Users, login and logout, sessions (signed cookies via itsdangerous), argon2 hashing, CSRF tokens on every state-changing form, first-login setup (password plus Display name), and account states (active / Submission ban / Deactivated).\n  - Login is by email, matching the existing `client_as` test fixture. The Display name is separate, unique, and the only name shown publicly.\n  - Roles are bundles of capabilities. Route code checks a capability, not a role name, so a rule can change without touching routes.\n- **Guide workflow.** A deep module that owns every state change and its permission check: create, save, Submit, Publish, Return (with Review notes), Unpublish, open and Submit a Revision, delete to Trash, restore, delete for good. Its interface takes the acting user and the Guide, and either performs the change or refuses with a reason the console can show. No route changes Guide status directly.\n  - Guide states: Draft → Submitted → Published, with Return and Unpublish leading back to Draft. \"In Trash\" is separate from status, so a restored Guide comes back exactly as it was.\n  - A Revision is a pending copy of a Published Guide's editable fields (texts, Hero, Patch, images, cover), with its own Draft/Submitted state. There is at most one per Guide. Publishing it overwrites the Guide's fields and updates its timestamp. The old content isn't kept. Returning it leaves the Guide untouched.\n  - Admin edits to a Published Guide apply directly with no Revision.\n  - Submit requires Chinese text and is refused under a Submission ban.\n  - Review notes belong to the Guide and each stores a quoted passage, the advice, the Admin, and the time. They are kept across rounds.\n- **Content.**\n  - Guides have per-language title and body (Chinese required to Submit, English optional), a Hero, a Patch, the Author, a cover image, and created/updated/published timestamps.\n  - Pages have per-language text, a status (Draft/Published) and an Admin-set ASCII slug. Only Admins can manage them, with no review.\n  - Tournament items are of kind announcement or recap, with per-language text, a Tournament date, a Patch, an optional cover, an optional link from recap to announcement, and a Draft/Published status. Only Admins can manage them.\n- **Game Terms and Patches.**\n  - **Game Terms:** each has one of the seven kinds, both Official names (both required), and an optional list of nicknames. Heroes also have a URL slug from the English name.\n  - **CSV import:** uses Python's standard library, previews the changes, and rejects rows per row with a reason.\n  - **Patches:** a Patch is an ordered list entry, and the newest one is the Current Patch. The Guide form offers the Current Patch and the two before it, and still shows a Guide's existing older Patch.\n- **Markdown rendering.** One function used by both the editor preview and the Site build:\n  1. Markdown is turned into HTML with markdown-it-py.\n  2. `[[term]]` markers become the Official name in the target language, matched by either language's name, and styled as a term.\n  3. The HTML is sanitized with nh3.\n\n  The same pass returns warnings (unknown terms, unmarked nicknames) for the preview. Warnings never block Submit. Review notes' quoted passages are highlighted in the preview only, never on the public site.\n- **Media.**\n  - **Accepted files:** PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF only (no SVG), checked by content as well as extension. 5 MB maximum each.\n  - **Storage:** server-generated filenames. Images are owned by a Guide (or a Tournament item) and usable from either language's text. Each image has optional per-language alt text.\n  - **Site build and deletion:** images are copied into the site output during the Site build, and deleted with their owner when it is deleted for good.\n- **Site build.** It is an extension of the existing `render_site(out)`.\n  - **Output:** two trees, `zh/` and `en/`. The root `index.html` sends Readers to `zh/`.\n  - **Pages written per language:** the home page, a Guides index, one page per Hero, one per Author with at least one Published Guide, one per Guide, the Tournaments list and each item, and each Published Page.\n  - **Language filter:** the English tree includes only items with English text. Hero and Author pages exist in both trees, with an empty notice when needed.\n  - **Links:** every link is relative, computed from each page's depth. The language switch links to the same page in the other tree, or falls back to the Hero page with a notice.\n  - **What is excluded:** only Published, non-Trash content is read, so open Revisions are never seen.\n  - **Deploy:** the existing `cms deploy` (ghp-import) puts the site online. The console's 更新网站 button runs render plus deploy and shows the result. The CLI commands stay as they are.\n  - The dashboard's \"changes not yet on the site\" count compares content change times with the last successful Site build.\n- **URLs.**\n  - **Guides:** `guides/<hero-slug>-<id>/`. The slug is generated on creation, Admins can edit it, and it is unique. It never changes on its own with a title or Revision.\n  - **Other pages:** Heroes `heroes/<slug>/`, Authors `authors/<id>/` (never the email), Tournament items `tournaments/<id>/`, Pages `<page-slug>/`.\n- **Admin console.** Server-rendered Jinja templates with Chinese labels throughout:\n  - a role-aware dashboard,\n  - the filterable content list,\n  - the Guide editor with preview, image upload, cover choice and alt text,\n  - a review screen with a Review note builder,\n  - the Users page, the Trash, Game Terms with CSV import, and Patches.\n\n  Navigation stays on every page, and every save shows a success or error message.\n- **Storage.** SQLite at `CMS_DATABASE`. The schema is created on startup. `scripts/seed_demo.py` creates one Admin and one Editor from environment passwords, plus demo Heroes, Patches, Game Terms, Guides in every status, a Page and Tournament items.\n- **Architecture.** ADR-001 and ADR-002 stand for all core work. The hosted console is a stretch ticket. When it starts, ADR-003 will supersede ADR-001 for the console, and the `CLAUDE.md` \"never on the public internet\" rule will be updated in the same change. Until then the console runs on one machine. That is a known gap for a real multi-author deployment.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\n- **A good test** drives the system the way a user does and checks what a user would see: an HTTP response, a redirect, a page's text, or a file in the built site. Tests never inspect database rows or call private helpers, so the internals can be rebuilt without rewriting tests. Test names use the `CONTEXT.md` vocabulary (e.g. `test_editor_cannot_publish_a_submitted_guide`).\n- **Seam 1: the admin console over HTTP.** This uses the existing `client` and `client_as(role)` fixtures. It covers login and logout, account states, CSRF rejection, every permission rule (including Editors refused on Admin routes by URL), the full Guide workflow, Revisions, Review notes, Trash, Submission bans, user management guards, Game Term CSV import, Patch handling, image upload validation, and preview warnings.\n- **Seam 2: the Site build.** This uses the existing `render_site(out)` into a temporary folder, after content is set up through Seam 1. It covers:\n  - Published-only output: no Drafts, Submitted Guides, open Revisions or Trash.\n  - Relative paths only, across every generated page.\n  - Sanitized Markdown: injected script is stripped.\n  - `[[term]]` rendering per language.\n  - The English tree excluding Chinese-only items.\n  - Hero pages grouped by Patch.\n  - Author pages using Display names only.\n  - Navigation built from Published Pages.\n      17 templates/site/base.html\n      18 templates/admin/setup.html\n      20 app/settings.py\n      22 templates/admin/dashboard.html\n      23 templates/admin/guide_preview.html\n      24 app/routes/dashboard.py\n      24 templates/admin/patches.html\n      26 tests/test_t03_seed.py\n      28 app/rendering.py\n      28 templates/admin/heroes.html\n      31 app/routes/site.py\n      31 tests/test_t00.py\n      43 tests/test_t02_seed.py\n      49 app/main.py\n      52 app/cli.py\n      57 templates/admin/base.html\n      58 tests/test_t01_seed.py\n      61 templates/admin/guide_edit.html\n      69 tests/test_usage_report.py\n      70 templates/admin/guides.html\n      76 app/routes/auth.py\n      93 app/db.py\n      98 tests/test_ctx_guard.py\n     100 tests/test_console_links.py\n     102 tests/conftest.py\n     111 scripts/usage_report.py\n     114 app/routes/game.py\n     128 scripts/seed_demo.py\n     147 app/game.py\n     147 app/web.py\n     154 scripts/check_submission.py\n     183 app/accounts.py\n     194 app/publish.py\n     198 app/routes/guides.py\n     209 tests/test_t01_login.py\n     238 tests/test_t02_heroes_patches.py\n     279 tests/test_t04_site_build.py\n     330 app/guides.py\n     543 tests/test_t03_guides.py\n    4335 total","is_error":false}]}}

Login is by email, matching the existing `client_as` test fixture. The Display name is separate, unique, and the only name shown publicly.\n  - Roles are bundles of capabilities. Route code checks a capability, not a role name, so a rule can change without touching routes.\n- **Guide workflow.** A deep module that owns every state change and its permission check: create, save, Submit, Publish, Return (with Review notes), Unpublish, open and Submit a Revision, delete to Trash, restore, delete for good. Its interface takes the acting user and the Guide, and either performs the change or refuses with a reason the console can show. No route changes Guide status directly.\n  - Guide states: Draft → Submitted → Published, with Return and Unpublish leading back to Draft. \"In Trash\" is separate from status, so a restored Guide comes back exactly as it was.\n  - A Revision is a pending copy of a Published Guide's editable fields (texts, Hero, Patch, images, cover), with its own Draft/Submitted state. There is at most one per Guide. Publishing it overwrites the Guide's fields and updates its timestamp. The old content isn't kept. Returning it leaves the Guide untouched.\n  - Admin edits to a Published Guide apply directly with no Revision.\n  - Submit requires Chinese text and is refused under a Submission ban.\n  - Review notes belong to the Guide and each stores a quoted passage, the advice, the Admin, and the time. They are kept across rounds.\n- **Content.**\n  - Guides have per-language title and body (Chinese required to Submit, English optional), a Hero, a Patch, the Author, a cover image, and created/updated/published timestamps.\n  - Pages have per-language text, a status (Draft/Published) and an Admin-set ASCII slug. Only Admins can manage them, with no review.\n  - Tournament items are of kind announcement or recap, with per-language text, a Tournament date, a Patch, an optional cover, an optional link from recap to announcement, and a Draft/Published status. Only Admins can manage them.\n- **Game Terms and Patches.**\n  - **Game Terms:** each has one of the seven kinds, both Official names (both required), and an optional list of nicknames. Heroes also have a URL slug from the English name.\n  - **CSV import:** uses Python's standard library, previews the changes, and rejects rows per row with a reason.\n  - **Patches:** a Patch is an ordered list entry, and the newest one is the Current Patch. The Guide form offers the Current Patch and the two before it, and still shows a Guide's existing older Patch.\n- **Markdown rendering.** One function used by both the editor preview and the Site build:\n  1. Markdown is turned into HTML with markdown-it-py.\n  2. `[[term]]` markers become the Official name in the target language, matched by either language's name, and styled as a term.\n  3. The HTML is sanitized with nh3.\n\n  The same pass returns warnings (unknown terms, unmarked nicknames) for the preview. Warnings never block Submit. Review notes' quoted passages are highlighted in the preview only, never on the public site.\n- **Media.**\n  - **Accepted files:** PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF only (no SVG), checked by content as well as extension. 5 MB maximum each.\n  - **Storage:** server-generated filenames. Images are owned by a Guide (or a Tournament item) and usable from either language's text. Each image has optional per-language alt text.\n  - **Site build and deletion:** images are copied into the site output during the Site build, and deleted with their owner when it is deleted for good.\n- **Site build.** It is an extension of the existing `render_site(out)`.\n  - **Output:** two trees, `zh/` and `en/`. The root `index.html` sends Readers to `zh/`.\n  - **Pages written per language:** the home page, a Guides index, one page per Hero, one per Author with at least one Published Guide, one per Guide, the Tournaments list and each item, and each Published Page.\n  - **Language filter:** the English tree includes only items with English text. Hero and Author pages exist in both trees, with an empty notice when needed.\n  - **Links:** every link is relative, computed from each page's depth. The language switch links to the same page in the other tree, or falls back to the Hero page with a notice.\n  - **What is excluded:** only Published, non-Trash content is read, so open Revisions are never seen.\n  - **Deploy:** the existing `cms deploy` (ghp-import) puts the site online. The console's 更新网站 button runs render plus deploy and shows the result. The CLI commands stay as they are.\n  - The dashboard's \"changes not yet on the site\" count compares content change times with the last successful Site build.\n- **URLs.**\n  - **Guides:** `guides/<hero-slug>-<id>/`. The slug is generated on creation, Admins can edit it, and it is unique. It never changes on its own with a title or Revision.\n  - **Other pages:** Heroes `heroes/<slug>/`, Authors `authors/<id>/` (never the email), Tournament items `tournaments/<id>/`, Pages `<page-slug>/`.\n- **Admin console.** Server-rendered Jinja templates with Chinese labels throughout:\n  - a role-aware dashboard,\n  - the filterable content list,\n  - the Guide editor with preview, image upload, cover choice and alt text,\n  - a review screen with a Review note builder,\n  - the Users page, the Trash, Game Terms with CSV import, and Patches.\n\n  Navigation stays on every page, and every save shows a success or error message.\n- **Storage.** SQLite at `CMS_DATABASE`. The schema is created on startup. `scripts/seed_demo.py` creates one Admin and one Editor from environment passwords, plus demo Heroes, Patches, Game Terms, Guides in every status, a Page and Tournament items.\n- **Architecture.** ADR-001 and ADR-002 stand for all core work. The hosted console is a stretch ticket. When it starts, ADR-003 will supersede ADR-001 for the console, and the `CLAUDE.md` \"never on the public internet\" rule will be updated in the same change. Until then the console runs on one machine. Routes never touch a Guide's\nrow themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it either\nmakes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    return Guide(**{field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__})\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\nLANGUAGE_LABELS = {\"en\": \"有英文版\", \"zh\": \"只有中文版\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFilter:\n    \"\"\"What the content list is narrowed to; None (or \"\") means any.\"\"\"\n    status: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    author_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n           filters: GuideFilter = GuideFilter()) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see that match `filters`, most recently updated\n    first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    clauses, values = [where], list(params)\n    for column, value in [(\"guides.status\", filters.status or None),\n                          (\"guides.hero_id\", filters.hero_id),\n                          (\"guides.author_id\", filters.author_id),\n                          (\"guides.patch_id\", filters.patch_id)]:\n        if value is not None:\n            clauses.append(f\"{column} = ?\")\n            values.append(value)\n    has_english = \"(guides.title_en != '' OR guides.body_en != '')\"\n    if filters.language == \"en\":\n        clauses.append(has_english)\n    elif filters.language == \"zh\":\n        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        values).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Guide, most recently updated first: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'published'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef authors(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(id, Display name) of everyone who wrote a Guide `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT users.id, users.display_name FROM guides\"\n        f\" JOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id WHERE {where}\"\n        \" ORDER BY users.display_name\", params).fetchall()\n    return [(row[\"id\"], row[\"display_name\"]) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n    return choices\n\n\ndef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n                            guide: Guide | None = None) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n    if hero is None:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, patch_id\n\n\ndef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n    assert guide_id is not None\n    slug, n = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", 1\n    # Only if an Admin already gave that slug to another Guide.\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        slug = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}-{n}\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))\n    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    assert new is not None\n    return new\n\n\ndef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound\n    return found\n\n\n_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n        return current.slug\n    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.status == \"published\" and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n\n\ndef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n\n\ndef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n        raise NotAllowed(\"你的账号已被禁止投稿：可以继续编辑草稿，但不能提交审核。\"\n                         \"如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n\n\ndef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n    if current.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides `actor` may see are in each status.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM guides WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" GROUP BY status\", params).fetchall()\n    found = {row[\"status\"]: row[\"n\"] for row in rows}\n    return {status: found.get(status, 0) for status in STATUS_LABELS}\n\"\"\"Guides in the console: the content list, the editor, and the workflow\nbuttons. Every change goes through app/guides.py, which decides who may make\nit; these routes only turn its answers into pages.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.guides import Guide, GuideFields\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(signed_in_user)])\n\n\ndef _id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    return int(value) if value.strip().isdigit() else None\n\n\ndef _fields_from(form: FormData) -> GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"The Guide form's fields. A missing text field counts as blank, so it\n    gets our message rather than a 422; the slug stays None unless the form\n    has a slug field (only Admins' does).\"\"\"\n    def text(name: str) -> str:\n        value = form.get(name)\n        return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n    slug = form.get(\"slug\")\n    return GuideFields(title_zh=text(\"title_zh\"), body_zh=text(\"body_zh\"),\n                       title_en=text(\"title_en\"), body_en=text(\"body_en\"),\n                       hero_id=_id_or_none(text(\"hero_id\")),\n                       patch_id=_id_or_none(text(\"patch_id\")),\n                       slug=slug if isinstance(slug, str) else None)\n\n\nasync def guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields:\n    return _fields_from(await request.form())\n\n\nasync def sent_guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a workflow button sent them along (it\n    sits inside the form), or None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return _fields_from(form) if \"hero_id\" in form else None\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: guides.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, guides.GuideNotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, guides.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | None,\n                fields: GuideFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn, guide)\n    title = f\"编辑攻略：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if guide else \"写攻略\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"guide\": guide, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"error\": error,\n         \"can_submit\": guide is not None and guides.can_submit(user, guide),\n         \"can_publish\": guide is not None and guides.can_publish(user, guide)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef visible_guide(guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Guide in the URL, or 404 if it doesn't exist or isn't this user's\n    to see.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        guide = guides.guide(conn, user, guide_id)\n    if guide is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return guide\n\n\ndef refused_page(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                 fields: GuideFields | None, refused: guides.Refused):\n    \"\"\"Show the editor again with the reason, keeping what was typed.\"\"\"\n    guide = visible_guide(guide_id, user)\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, fields or GuideFields.of(guide),\n                       error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef guide_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               status: str = \"\", hero: str = \"\", author: str = \"\",\n               patch: str = \"\", lang: str = \"\"):\n    filters = guides.GuideFilter(\n        status=status if status in guides.STATUS_LABELS else \"\",\n        hero_id=_id_or_none(hero), author_id=_id_or_none(author),\n        patch_id=_id_or_none(patch),\n        language=lang if lang in guides.LANGUAGE_LABELS else \"\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = guides.guides(conn, user, filters)\n        heroes, patches = game.heroes(conn), game.patches(conn)\n        authors = guides.authors(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guides.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"攻略\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed, \"filters\": filters,\n         \"statuses\": guides.STATUS_LABELS, \"languages\": guides.LANGUAGE_LABELS,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"authors\": authors,\n         \"filtered\": filters != guides.GuideFilter()})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/new\")\ndef new_guide_form(request: Request,\n                   user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn)\n    current = patches[0].id if patches else None\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, GuideFields(patch_id=current))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef create_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.create(conn, user, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide.id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_guide_form(request: Request,\n                    user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                    guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, GuideFields.of(guide))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/preview\")\ndef preview_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_preview.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"预览：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\", \"user\": user,\n         \"guide\": guide, \"body_zh\": render_markdown(guide.body_zh),\n         \"body_en\": render_markdown(guide.body_en)})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}\")\ndef save_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\nWorkflowStep = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, User, int], Guide]\n\n\ndef workflow_step(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                  fields: GuideFields | None, step: WorkflowStep, done: str):\n    \"\"\"Press a workflow button. When the editor form came along, its edits are\n    saved in the same transaction: if the step is refused they are not saved\n    either, and the editor shows them again with the reason.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if fields:\n                guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n            step(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/submit\")\ndef submit_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.submit,\n                         \"已提交审核，请等待管理员审核。\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.publish,\n                         \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会在公开网站上看到它。\")\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Markdown rendering: the one function that turns a writer's Markdown into\nthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview uses it, and so will the Site build,\nso the preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n\nWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\nwith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\nhandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\nsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\nfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True}).enable(\"table\")\n\n\ndef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out.\"\"\"\n    return nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text), attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls)\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false,"persistedOutputPath":"/Users/yining/.claude/projects/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032/tool-results/bbf3n081j.txt","persistedOutputSize":32529},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"42a09be1-f1be-4888-a857-abc650b006d6","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.status == \"published\" and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n\n\ndef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n\n\ndef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n        raise NotAllowed(\"你的账号已被禁止投稿：可以继续编辑草稿，但不能提交审核。\"\n                         \"如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n\n\ndef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n    if current.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides `actor` may see are in each status.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM guides WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" GROUP BY status\", params).fetchall()\n    found = {row[\"status\"]: row[\"n\"] for row in rows}\n    return {status: found.get(status, 0) for status in STATUS_LABELS}\n","numLines":257,"startLine":75,"totalLines":331}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a323974a-400b-4689-9fee-0709fbaf4252","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

Every change goes through app/guides.py, which decides who may make\nit; these routes only turn its answers into pages.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.guides import Guide, GuideFields\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(signed_in_user)])\n\n\ndef _id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    return int(value) if value.strip().isdigit() else None\n\n\ndef _fields_from(form: FormData) -> GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"The Guide form's fields. A missing text field counts as blank, so it\n    gets our message rather than a 422; the slug stays None unless the form\n    has a slug field (only Admins' does).\"\"\"\n    def text(name: str) -> str:\n        value = form.get(name)\n        return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n    slug = form.get(\"slug\")\n    return GuideFields(title_zh=text(\"title_zh\"), body_zh=text(\"body_zh\"),\n                       title_en=text(\"title_en\"), body_en=text(\"body_en\"),\n                       hero_id=_id_or_none(text(\"hero_id\")),\n                       patch_id=_id_or_none(text(\"patch_id\")),\n                       slug=slug if isinstance(slug, str) else None)\n\n\nasync def guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields:\n    return _fields_from(await request.form())\n\n\nasync def sent_guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a workflow button sent them along (it\n    sits inside the form), or None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return _fields_from(form) if \"hero_id\" in form else None\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: guides.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, guides.GuideNotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, guides.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | None,\n                fields: GuideFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn, guide)\n    title = f\"编辑攻略：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if guide else \"写攻略\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"guide\": guide, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"error\": error,\n         \"can_submit\": guide is not None and guides.can_submit(user, guide),\n         \"can_publish\": guide is not None and guides.can_publish(user, guide)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef visible_guide(guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Guide in the URL, or 404 if it doesn't exist or isn't this user's\n    to see.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        guide = guides.guide(conn, user, guide_id)\n    if guide is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return guide\n\n\ndef refused_page(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                 fields: GuideFields | None, refused: guides.Refused):\n    \"\"\"Show the editor again with the reason, keeping what was typed.\"\"\"\n    guide = visible_guide(guide_id, user)\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, fields or GuideFields.of(guide),\n                       error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef guide_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               status: str = \"\", hero: str = \"\", author: str = \"\",\n               patch: str = \"\", lang: str = \"\"):\n    filters = guides.GuideFilter(\n        status=status if status in guides.STATUS_LABELS else \"\",\n        hero_id=_id_or_none(hero), author_id=_id_or_none(author),\n        patch_id=_id_or_none(patch),\n        language=lang if lang in guides.LANGUAGE_LABELS else \"\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = guides.guides(conn, user, filters)\n        heroes, patches = game.heroes(conn), game.patches(conn)\n        authors = guides.authors(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guides.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"攻略\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed, \"filters\": filters,\n         \"statuses\": guides.STATUS_LABELS, \"languages\": guides.LANGUAGE_LABELS,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"authors\": authors,\n         \"filtered\": filters != guides.GuideFilter()})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/new\")\ndef new_guide_form(request: Request,\n                   user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn)\n    current = patches[0].id if patches else None\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, GuideFields(patch_id=current))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef create_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.create(conn, user, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide.id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_guide_form(request: Request,\n                    user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                    guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, GuideFields.of(guide))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/preview\")\ndef preview_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_preview.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"预览：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\", \"user\": user,\n         \"guide\": guide, \"body_zh\": render_markdown(guide.body_zh),\n         \"body_en\": render_markdown(guide.body_en)})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}\")\ndef save_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\nWorkflowStep = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, User, int], Guide]\n\n\ndef workflow_step(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                  fields: GuideFields | None, step: WorkflowStep, done: str):\n    \"\"\"Press a workflow button. When the editor form came along, its edits are\n    saved in the same transaction: if the step is refused they are not saved\n    either, and the editor shows them again with the reason.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if fields:\n                guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n            step(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/submit\")\ndef submit_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.submit,\n                         \"已提交审核，请等待管理员审核。\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.publish,\n                         \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会在公开网站上看到它。\")\n","numLines":199,"startLine":1,"totalLines":199}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ab7a24f1-561c-4ef7-8244-bc33460040af","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"916c349e-dff1-4a67-8405-82f42751d912","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"68955aea-1d9e-46df-85eb-b3a406dcaca0","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VPC7G5EKxUh3ZweJQLra5t","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. [(row[\"id\"], row[\"display_name\"]) for row in rows]\n177\t\n178\t\n179\tdef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | None = None\n180\t                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n181\t    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n182\t    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n183\t    patches = game.patches(conn)\n184\t    choices = patches[:3]\n185\t    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n186\t        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n187\t    return choices\n188\t\n189\t\n190\tdef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n191\t                            guide: Guide | None = None) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n192\t    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n193\t    if hero is None:\n194\t        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n195\t    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n196\t    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n197\t                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n198\t        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n199\t    return hero, patch_id\n200\t\n201\t\n202\tdef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n203\t    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n204\t    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n205\t    cur = conn.execute(\n206\t        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n207\t        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n208\t        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n209\t         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n210\t    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n211\t    assert guide_id is not None\n212\t    slug, n = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", 1\n213\t    # Only if an Admin already gave that slug to another Guide.\n214\t    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n215\t        n += 1\n216\t        slug = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}-{n}\"\n217\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))\n218\t    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n219\t    assert new is not None\n220\t    return new\n221\t\n222\t\n223\tdef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n224\t    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n225\t    if found is None:\n226\t        raise GuideNotFound\n227\t    return found\n228\t\n229\t\n230\t_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n231\t\n232\t\n233\tdef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n234\t                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n235\t    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n236\t    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n237\t        return current.slug\n238\t    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n239\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n240\t    slug = slug.strip()\n241\t    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n242\t        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n243\t    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n244\t                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n245\t        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n246\t    return slug\n247\t\n248\t\n249\tdef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n250\t         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n251\t    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n252\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n253\t    if current.status == \"published\" and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n254\t        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n255\t    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n256\t    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n257\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n258\t        _check_text(fields)\n259\t    conn.execute(\n260\t        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n261\t        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n262\t        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n263\t        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n264\t         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n265\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n266\t\n267\t\n268\tdef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide) -> None:\n269\t    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n270\t    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n271\t        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n272\t    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n273\t        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n274\t\n275\t\n276\tdef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n277\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n278\t    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n279\t    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n280\t            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n281\t\n282\t\n283\tdef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n284\t    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n285\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n286\t    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n287\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n288\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n289\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n290\t                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n291\t    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n292\t        raise NotAllowed(\"你的账号已被禁止投稿：可以继续编辑草稿，但不能提交审核。\"\n293\t                         \"如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n294\t    _check_text(current)\n295\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n296\t                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n297\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n298\t\n299\t\n300\tdef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n301\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n302\t    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n303\t    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n304\t        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n305\t        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n306\t\n307\t\n308\tdef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n309\t    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n310\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n311\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n312\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n313\t    if current.status == \"published\":\n314\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n315\t    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n316\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n317\t    _check_text(current)\n318\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n319\t                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n320\t                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n321\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n322\t\n323\t\n324\tdef counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[str, int]:\n325\t    \"\"\"How many Guides `actor` may see are in each status.\"\"\"\n326\t    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n327\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM guides WHERE {where}\"\n328\t                        \" GROUP BY status\", params).fetchall()\n329\t    found = {row[\"status\"]: row[\"n\"] for row in rows}\n330\t    return {status: found.get(status, 0) for status in STATUS_LABELS}\n331\t"},{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UCJdbjW5HpW6jRvJ5oi82m","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Guides in the console: the content list, the editor, and the workflow\n2\tbuttons.
