The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Markdown rendering: the one function that turns a writer's Markdown into\nthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview uses it, and so will the Site build,\nso the preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n\nWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\nwith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\nhandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\nsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\nfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True}).enable(\"table\")\n\n\ndef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out.\"\"\"\n    return nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text), attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls)\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef admin_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in Admin. Editors are\n    refused, whether they followed a link or typed the URL.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if not user.can(\"manage_game\"):\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"只有管理员可以使用此页面。\", status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"The console dashboard. /admin itself stays The Site build writes into a temporary folder, and\nits deploy step is replaced, so no test ever pushes to gh-pages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\",\n              \"display_name\": \"演示管理员\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\",\n               \"display_name\": \"演示编辑\"},\n}\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database per test, seeded with DEMO_USERS.\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(tmp_path / \"cms.db\"))\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n            accounts.create_user(conn, email=user[\"email\"],\n                                 password=user[\"password\"], role=role,\n                                 display_name=user[\"display_name\"])\n    return tmp_path / \"cms.db\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef deploys(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> list[Path]:\n    \"\"\"The folders the Site build deployed, in order. A test can replace\n    `app.publish.deploy` again to make the push fail.\"\"\"\n    from app import publish, settings\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    pushed: list[Path] = []\n    monkeypatch.setattr(publish, \"deploy\", lambda out, *_: pushed.append(out))\n    return pushed\n\n\ndef add_user(**fields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Arrange an extra account (until the Users page exists to make one).\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.create_user(conn, **fields)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(page_html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered console form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', page_html)\n    assert match, \"page has no CSRF token\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef login(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n    \"\"\"Submit the login form the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    return c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                  \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client() -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as():\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        if c.get(\"/login\").status_code == 404:\n            pytest.skip(\"No /login route yet — build the login ticket first.\")\n        response = login(c, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"])\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\n\"\"\"T03: Editors write and Submit Guides; Admins Publish them (Seam 1: the\nconsole over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom conftest import add_user, csrf_token, login\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import submit as fill_in\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"An Admin, with Heroes and \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n               name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    for name in [\"6.4\", \"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]:\n        fill_in(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"hero_id\": hero_id(c, \"瓦妮莎（Vanessa）\"),\n                \"patch_id\": patch_id(c, \"6.7（当前版本）\")}\n    return defaults | fields\n\n\ndef new_guide(c: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","hash":"b672ac300e897661411e594c5a4ed13cc99a0b61e4fbd4239452578d340c6ee0","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_013a3EzwGu8fqg2EQ5rxCGT3","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]}}

Admins Return or Unpublish Guides with Review notes (Seam 1: the\nconsole over HTTP; Seam 2: what the Site build writes).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\nfrom test_t03_guides import (act, admin, editor, new_guide,  # noqa: F401\n                             status_of)\n\nBODY = \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船，再拿炮。\\n\\n别忘了买**锚**。\"\n\n\ndef submitted_guide(editor: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A Guide the Editor wrote and Submitted; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, **({\"body_zh\": BODY} | fields))\n    assert act(editor, edit_page, \"submit\").status_code == 303\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef review(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, action: str,\n           notes: list[tuple[str, str]]):\n    \"\"\"Fill in the review screen's Review notes and press Return (return) or\n    Unpublish (unpublish).\"\"\"\n    guide = edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    page = c.get(f\"{guide}/review\")\n    token = csrf_token(page.text) if page.status_code == 200 else (\n        csrf_token(c.get(\"/admin/guides\").text))\n Starting with Slice 1—an Admin returning a submitted guide with review notes—by writing the failing test first.\n\n","signature":""},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019h1LWc8rtz597Tyz8v4LeA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_t05_review.py","content":"\"\"\"T05: Admins Return or Unpublish Guides with Review notes (Seam 1: the\nconsole over HTTP; Seam 2: what the Site build writes).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\nfrom test_t03_guides import (act, admin, editor, new_guide,  # noqa: F401\n                             status_of)\n\nBODY = \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船，再拿炮。\\n\\n别忘了买**锚**。\"\n\n\ndef submitted_guide(editor: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A Guide the Editor wrote and Submitted; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, **({\"body_zh\": BODY} | fields))\n    assert act(editor, edit_page, \"submit\").status_code == 303\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef review(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, action: str,\n           notes: list[tuple[str, str]]):\n    \"\"\"Fill in the review screen's Review notes and press Return (return) or\n    Unpublish (unpublish).\"\"\"\n    guide = edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    page = c.get(f\"{guide}/review\")\n    token = csrf_token(page.text) if page.status_code == 200 else (\n        csrf_token(c.get(\"/admin/guides\").text))\n    data: dict[str, str | list[str]] = {\n        \"csrf_token\": token, \"quote\": [quote for quote, _ in notes],\n        \"advice\": [advice for _, advice in notes]}\n    return c.post(f\"{guide}/{action}\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_admin_returns_a_submitted_guide_with_review_notes(editor, admin):\n    edit_page = submitted_guide(editor)\n    response = review(admin, edit_page, \"return\",\n                      [(\"先拿船\", \"开局拿船太慢，先说明经济。\"),\n                       (\"锚\", \"锚在 6.7 被削弱了。\")])\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert status_of(editor, edit_page) == \"草稿\"\n    assert \"已退回\" in admin.get(response.headers[\"location\"]).text\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NVqu9LbdGg32S77mEsEKyd","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"uv run pytest -q tests/test_t05_review.py 2>&1 | tail -5"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_notes (\n    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    quote    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quote != ''),\n    advice   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (advice != '')\n);\n\n-- One row per successful Site it.\"\"\"\n    quote: str\n    advice: str\n\n\nROUND_LABELS = {\"return\": \"退回\", \"unpublish\": \"撤下\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewRound:\n    \"\"\"One Return or Unpublish, with the Review notes the Admin gave.\"\"\"\n    kind: str\n    admin_name: str\n    created_at: str\n    notes: tuple[ReviewNote, ...]\n\n    @property\n    def label(self) -> str:\n        return ROUND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n\ndef can_review(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the review screen for `guide`: Admins Return\n    (or Publish) a Submitted Guide and Unpublish a Published one.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\")\n\n\ndef _checked_notes(notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n    notes = [ReviewNote(note.quote.strip(), note.advice.strip()) for note in notes]\n    if any(not note.quote or not note.advice for note in notes):\n        raise Refused(\"每条审核意见都要有引用的段落和修改建议。\")\n    return notes\n\n\ndef _send_back(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int, kind: str,\n               notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Turn the Guide back into a Draft for its conn.executemany(\"INSERT INTO review_notes (round_id, quote, advice)\"\n                     \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n                     [(cur.lastrowid, note.quote, note.advice) for note in notes])\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'draft',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef return_guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n                 notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Guide back to its Author as a Draft, with at\n    least one Review note saying what to fix.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的攻略。\")\n    notes = _checked_notes(notes)\n    if not notes:\n        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n    return _send_back(conn, actor, guide_id, \"return\", notes)\n\n\ndef counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[str, int]:"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

Rows left wholly blank are\n    dropped; a half-filled row is kept, for app/guides.py to refuse.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    quotes, advice = form.getlist(\"quote\"), form.getlist(\"advice\")\n    rows = zip_longest(quotes, advice, fillvalue=\"\")\n    return [ReviewNote(quote, text) for quote, text in rows\n            if isinstance(quote, str) and isinstance(text, str)\n            and (quote.strip() or text.strip())]\n\n\nBLANK_NOTE_ROWS = 3\n\n\ndef review_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide,\n                notes: list[ReviewNote], *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    rows = notes + [ReviewNote(\"\", \"\")] * max(BLANK_NOTE_ROWS - len(notes), 1)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_review.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"审核：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\", \"user\": user,\n         \"guide\": guide, \"notes\": rows, \"error\": error,\n         \"body_zh\": render_markdown(guide.body_zh),\n         \"body_en\": render_markdown(guide.body_en)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/review\")\ndef review_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    if not user.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return review_page(request, user, guide, [])\n\n\nReviewStep = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, User, int, list[ReviewNote]], Guide]\n\n\ndef review_step(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                notes: list[ReviewNote], step: ReviewStep, done: str):\n    \"\"\"Send a Guide back with the Review notes from the review screen. If\n    that is refused, the screen shows the reason and keeps what was typed.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            step(conn, user, guide_id, notes)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        guide = visible_guide(guide_id, user)\n        if not user.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n            return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, None, refused)\n        return review_page(request, user, guide, notes, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/return\")\ndef return_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, If\n    that is refused, the screen shows the reason and keeps what was typed.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            step(conn, user, guide_id, notes)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        guide = visible_guide(guide_id, user)\n        if not user.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n            return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, None, refused)\n        return review_page(request, user, guide, notes, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/return\")\ndef return_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 notes: Annotated[list[ReviewNote], Depends(sent_review_notes)]):\n    return review_step(request, user, guide_id, notes, guides.return_guide,\n                       \"已退回给作者，作者会在草稿顶部看到审核意见。\")","originalFile":"\"\"\"Guides in the console: the content list, the editor, and the workflow\nbuttons. Every change goes through app/guides.py, which decides who may make\nit; these routes only turn its answers into pages.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.guides import Guide, GuideFields\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(signed_in_user)])\n\n\ndef _id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    return int(value) if value.strip().isdigit() else None\n\n\ndef _fields_from(form: FormData) -> GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"The Guide form's fields. A missing text field counts as blank, so it\n    gets our message rather than a 422; the slug stays None unless the form\n    has a slug field (only Admins' does).\"\"\"\n    def text(name: str) -> str:\n        value = form.get(name)\n        return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n    slug = form.get(\"slug\")\n    return GuideFields(title_zh=text(\"title_zh\"), body_zh=text(\"body_zh\"),\n                       title_en=text(\"title_en\"), body_en=text(\"body_en\"),\n                       hero_id=_id_or_none(text(\"hero_id\")),\n                       patch_id=_id_or_none(text(\"patch_id\")),\n                       slug=slug if isinstance(slug, str) else None)\n\n\nasync def guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields:\n    return _fields_from(await request.form())\n\n\nasync def sent_guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a workflow button sent them along (it\n    sits inside the form), or None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return _fields_from(form) if \"hero_id\" in form else None\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: guides.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, guides.GuideNotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, guides.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | None,\n                fields: GuideFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn, guide)\n    title = f\"编辑攻略：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if guide else \"写攻略\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"guide\": guide, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"error\": error,\n         \"can_submit\": guide is not None and guides.can_submit(user, guide),\n         \"can_publish\": guide is not None and guides.can_publish(user, guide)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef visible_guide(guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Guide in the URL, or 404 if it doesn't exist or isn't this user's\n    to see.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        guide = guides.guide(conn, user, guide_id)\n    if guide is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return guide\n\n\ndef refused_page(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                 fields: GuideFields | None, refused: guides.Refused):\n    \"\"\"Show the editor again with the reason, keeping what was typed.\"\"\"\n    guide = visible_guide(guide_id, user)\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, fields or GuideFields.of(guide),\n                       error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef guide_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               status: str = \"\", hero: str = \"\", author: str = \"\",\n               patch: str = \"\", lang: str = \"\"):\n    filters = guides.GuideFilter(\n        status=status if status in guides.STATUS_LABELS else \"\",\n        hero_id=_id_or_none(hero), author_id=_id_or_none(author),\n        patch_id=_id_or_none(patch),\n        language=lang if lang in guides.LANGUAGE_LABELS else \"\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = guides.guides(conn, user, filters)\n        heroes, patches = game.heroes(conn), game.patches(conn)\n        authors = guides.authors(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guides.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"攻略\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed, \"filters\": filters,\n         \"statuses\": guides.STATUS_LABELS, \"languages\": guides.LANGUAGE_LABELS,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"authors\": authors,\n         \"filtered\": filters != guides.GuideFilter()})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/new\")\ndef new_guide_form(request: Request,\n                   user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn)\n    current = patches[0].id if patches else None\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, GuideFields(patch_id=current))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef create_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.create(conn, user, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide.id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_guide_form(request: Request,\n                    user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                    guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, GuideFields.of(guide))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/preview\")\ndef preview_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_preview.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"预览：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\", \"user\": user,\n         \"guide\": guide, \"body_zh\": render_markdown(guide.body_zh),\n         \"body_en\": render_markdown(guide.body_en)})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}\")\ndef save_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\nWorkflowStep = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, User, int], Guide]\n\n\ndef workflow_step(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                  fields: GuideFields | None, step: WorkflowStep, done: str):\n    \"\"\"Press a workflow button. When the editor form came along, its edits are\n    saved in the same transaction: if the step is refused they are not saved\n    either, and the editor shows them again with the reason.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if fields:\n                guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n            step(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/submit\")\ndef submit_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.submit,\n                         \"已提交审核，请等待管理员审核。\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.publish,\n                         \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会在公开网站上看到它。\")\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":196,"oldLines":3,"newStart":196,"newLines":66,"lines":["                   fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):","     return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.publish,","                          \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会在公开网站上看到它。\")","+","+","+async def sent_review_notes(request: Request) -> list[ReviewNote]:","+    \"\"\"The Review note builder's rows, in order. If\n    that is refused, the screen shows the reason and keeps what was typed.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            step(conn, user, guide_id, notes)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        guide = visible_guide(guide_id, user)\n        if not user.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n            return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, None, refused)\n        return review_page(request, user, guide, notes, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/return\")\ndef return_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 notes: Annotated[list[ReviewNote], Depends(sent_review_notes)]):\n    return review_step(request, user, guide_id, notes, guides.return_guide,\n                       \"已退回给作者，作者会在草稿顶部看到审核意见。\")"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01N8wZMEyaLRFkgoqtW3REf1","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/routes/guides.py","old_string":"import extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/guides/{{ guide.id }}/edit\">返回编辑</a>\n    · 状态：{{ guide.status_label }} · 作者：{{ guide.author_name }}\n    · {{ guide.hero_name_zh }} · {{ guide.patch_name }}</p>\n\n  <article lang=\"zh-CN\">\n    <h2>{{ guide.title_zh or \"（无标题）\" }}</h2>\n    {{ body_zh | safe }}\n  </article>\n  {% if guide.title_en or guide.body_en %}\n  <hr>\n  <article lang=\"en\">\n    <h2>{{ guide.title_en or \"(untitled)\" }}</h2>\n    {{ body_en | safe }}\n  </article>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  {% if guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\") %}\n  <hr>\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/guides/{{ guide.id }}/{{ 'return' if guide.status == 'submitted' else 'unpublish' }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <h2>审核意见{% if guide.status == \"published\" %}（可选）{% endif %}</h2>\n    <p>每条意见引用攻略正文里的一段原文（从上面复制），再写上修改建议。空着的行会被忽略。</p>\n    <div id=\"review-notes\">\n      {% for note in notes %}\n      <fieldset class=\"review-note\">\n        <label>引用的段落\n          <textarea name=\"quote\" rows=\"2\">{{ note.quote }}</textarea>\n        </label>\n        <label>修改建议\n          <textarea name=\"advice\" rows=\"3\">{{ note.advice }}</textarea>\n        </label>\n      </fieldset>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </div>\n    <p><button type=\"button\" id=\"add-note\" hidden>再加一条意见</button></p>\n    {% if guide.status == \"submitted\" %}\n    <button type=\"submit\">退回给作者</button>\n    <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/guides/{{ guide.id }}/publish\">发布</button>\n    {% else %}\n    <p>撤下后，这篇攻略会作为草稿回到作者手里，下次“更新网站”时从网站上消失。</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">撤下</button>\n    {% endif %}\n  </form>\n  <script>\n    // Without this script the three rows above are all there is.\n    const add = document.getElementById(\"add-note\");\n    const rows = document.getElementById(\"review-notes\");\n    add.hidden = false;\n    add.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n      const row = rows.querySelector(\".review-note\").cloneNode(true);\n      row.querySelectorAll(\"textarea\").forEach((field) => { field.value = \"\"; });\n      rows.append(row);\n    });\n  </script>\n  {% else %}\n  <p>只有待审核或已发布的攻略需要审核。</p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_011smarJcgZRUkBMEaaDhsBs","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"uv run pytest -q tests/test_t05_review.py 2>&1 | tail -5"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

'admin/guides' }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <label>英雄\n      <select name=\"hero_id\" required>\n        <option value=\"\">请选择英雄</option>\n        {% for hero in heroes %}\n        <option value=\"{{ hero.id }}\"{% if hero.id == fields.hero_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ hero.name_zh }}（{{ hero.name_en }}）</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>版本\n      <select name=\"patch_id\" required>\n        {% for patch in patches %}\n        <option value=\"{{ patch.id }}\"{% if patch.id == fields.patch_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ patch.name }}{% if patch.is_current %}（当前版本）{% endif %}</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    {% if guide and user.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\") %}\n    <label>网址名（公开网址 guides/网址名/，改动后旧链接会失效）\n      <input type=\"text\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ fields.slug }}\" required pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\">\n    </label>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>中文版（提交审核前必须填写）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"title_zh\" value=\"{{ fields.title_zh }}\">\n      </label>\n {"parentUuid":"74eb2806-fa9b-4a75-bef5-92ceff8736d9","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"68955aea-1d9e-46df-85eb-b3a406dcaca0","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VwMmwwp4wuuK3zeN6bjswi","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/rendering.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"c3d3a161-f955-4c47-a8dd-a233efd8e616","timestamp":"2026-10-17T19:47:54.279Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/rendering.py","oldString":"    longest_first = sorted(patterns.values(), key=len, reverse=True)\n    highlighter = _Highlighter(re.compile(\"|\".join(longest_first)))","newString":"    longest_first = sorted(patterns, key=lambda quote: len(\"\".join(quote.split())),\n                           reverse=True)\n    highlighter = _Highlighter(re.compile(\n        \"|\".join(patterns[quote] for quote in longest_first)))","originalFile":"\"\"\"Markdown rendering: the one function that turns a writer's Markdown into\nthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview uses it, and so will the Site build,\nso the preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n\nWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\nwith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\nhandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\nsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\nfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\nfrom html import escape\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True}).enable(\"table\")\n\n\ndef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out.\"\"\"\n    return nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text), attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls)\n\n\nclass _Highlighter(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Copies sanitized HTML, wrapping each match of `pattern` in its text in\n    <mark>. Tags are copied as they came, so attributes are never touched.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, pattern: re.Pattern[str]) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.pattern = pattern\n        self.out: list[str] = []\n        self.runs: list[str] = []  # the text, one run between tags at a time\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        self.out.append(self.get_starttag_text() or \"\")\n\n    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        self.out.append(f\"</{tag}>\")\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        self.runs.append(data)\n        done = 0\n        for match in self.pattern.finditer(data):\n            self.out += [escape(data[done:match.start()], quote=False),\n                         f\"<mark>{escape(match.group(), quote=False)}</mark>\"]\n            done = match.end()\n        self.out.append(escape(data[done:], quote=False))\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. A quote is matched as\n    Readers see the text, ignoring whitespace, but it must lie within one run\n    of text: a passage that crosses formatting (part bold, part not) is not\n    found. Where quotes overlap, the longest is marked.\"\"\"\n    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n    # characters of a quote.\n    patterns = {quote: r\"\\s*\".join(map(re.escape, \"\".join(quote.split())))\n                for quote in quotes if quote.split()}\n    if not patterns:\n        return html, set()\n    longest_first = sorted(patterns.values(), key=len, reverse=True)\n    highlighter = _Highlighter(re.compile(\"|\".join(longest_first)))\n    highlighter.feed(html)\n    highlighter.close()\n    return \"\".join(highlighter.out), {\n        quote for quote, pattern in patterns.items()\n        if any(re.search(pattern, run) for run in highlighter.runs)}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":74,"oldLines":8,"newStart":74,"newLines":10,"lines":["                 for quote in quotes if quote.split()}","     if not patterns:","         return html, set()","-    longest_first = sorted(patterns.values(), key=len, reverse=True)","-    highlighter = _Highlighter(re.compile(\"|\".join(longest_first)))","+    longest_first = sorted(patterns, key=lambda quote: len(\"\".join(quote.split())),","+                           reverse=True)","+    highlighter = _Highlighter(re.compile(","+        \"|\".join(patterns[quote] for quote in longest_first)))","     highlighter.feed(html)","     highlighter.close()","     return \"\".join(highlighter.out), {"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"74eb2806-fa9b-4a75-bef5-92ceff8736d9","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

seed_guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    admin = _seed_user(conn, \"admin\")\n    if guides.guides(conn, admin):\n        print(\"guides: some already exist, none added.\")\n        return\n    heroes = {hero.name_en: hero.id for hero in game.heroes(conn)}\n    patches = {patch.name: patch.id for patch in game.patches(conn)}\n    for (role, hero, patch, status, title_zh, body_zh,\n         title_en, body_en) in DEMO_GUIDES:\n        author = _seed_user(conn, role)\n        guide = guides.create(conn, author, guides.GuideFields(\n            title_zh=title_zh, body_zh=body_zh, title_en=title_en,\n            body_en=body_en, hero_id=heroes[hero], patch_id=patches[patch]))\n        if status != \"draft\" and guides.can_submit(author, guide):\n            guides.submit(conn, author, guide.id)\n        if status == \"published\":\n            guides.publish(conn, admin, guide.id)\n        print(f\"guide: created {title_zh} ({guides.STATUS_LABELS[status]}).\")\n\n\ndef _seed_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, role: str) -> accounts.User:\n    email = next(email for r, email, *_ in DEMO_USERS if r == role)\n    user = accounts.user_with_email(conn, email)\n    assert user is not None, f\"{email} should have been created above\"\n    return user\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    missing = [var for *_, var in DEMO_USERS if not os.environ.get(var)]\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {' and '.join(missing)} in .env (copy .env.example), then run \"\n              \"`uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py`.\")\n        return 1\n\n    for *_, var in DEMO_USERS:\n        if os.environ[var].startswith(\"change-me\"):\n            print(f\"Warning: {var} is still the .env.example placeholder. \"\n                  \"Change it in .env before anyone else can reach this console.\")\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, email, display_name, var in DEMO_USERS:\n            try:\n                accounts.create_user(conn, email=email, password=os.environ[var],\n                                     role=role, display_name=display_name)\n            except accounts.Refused:\n                print(f\"{role}: {email} already exists, left unchanged.\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"{role}: created {email} (password from {var}).\")\n        for name_zh, name_en in DEMO_HEROES:\n            try:\n                game.add_hero(conn, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n            except game.Refused as refused:\n                print(f\"hero: {name_en} left unchanged ({refused.message})\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"hero: created {name_zh} ({name_en}).\")\n        for name in DEMO_PATCHES:\n            try:\n                game.add_patch(conn, name)\n            except game.Refused as refused:\n                print(f\"patch: {name} left unchanged ({refused.message})\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"patch: created {name}.\")\n        seed_guides(conn)\n    print(f\"Database: {settings.database_path()}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n\"\"\"T03: the seed script adds demo Guides in every status (checked through the\nconsole).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom test_t02_seed import seeded_admin\nfrom test_t03_guides import dashboard_counts\n\n\ndef test_seed_creates_demo_guides_in_draft_submitted_and_published(tmp_path,\n                                                                   monkeypatch):\n    admin = seeded_admin(tmp_path, monkeypatch)\n    by_status = dashboard_counts(admin)\n    assert set(by_status) == {\"草稿\", \"待审核\", \"已发布\"}\n    assert all(n >= 1 for n in by_status.values()), by_status\n    assert \"演示编辑\" in admin.get(\"/admin/guides?status=submitted\").text\n\n\ndef test_seeding_twice_adds_no_duplicate_guides(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    once_dir, twice_dir = tmp_path / \"once\", tmp_path / \"twice\"\n    once_dir.mkdir()\n    twice_dir.mkdir()\n    once: TestClient = seeded_admin(once_dir, monkeypatch)\n    assert dashboard_counts(once) == dashboard_counts(\n        seeded_admin(twice_dir, monkeypatch, times=2))","is_error":false}]}}

{"type":"queue-operation","operation":"enqueue","timestamp":"2026-10-17T19:52:08.956Z","sessionId":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","content":"<task-notification>\n<task-id>aede128257d6bd940</task-id>\n<tool-use-id>toolu_01N5pVAvXEHy4ZEkhJ5W1HMd</tool-use-id>\n<output-file>/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032/tasks/aede128257d6bd940.output</output-file>\n<status>completed</status>\n<summary>Agent \"/code-review\" finished</summary>\n<note>A task-notification fires each time this agent stops with no live background children of its own. The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>```json\n[\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/guides.py\",\n    \"line\": 440,\n    \"summary\": \"Return and Unpublish check the Guide's status and then write it in two separate steps, and the final UPDATE never re-checks the status, so two Admins acting on the same Guide can overwrite each other.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Python's sqlite3 module only opens a transaction at the first INSERT or UPDATE, so the status SELECT in `_editable` runs outside it. Admin A opens the review screen and presses 退回. Between A's status read and A's INSERT, Admin B presses 发布 and commits. A then inserts a 'return' round and runs `UPDATE guides SET status='draft'`. The Guide B just Published silently becomes a Draft again, and its history shows a Return of a Guide that was Published, which `return_guide` is meant to forbid. Fix: add `AND status = ?` to the UPDATE and check rowcount, or start the transaction with BEGIN IMMEDIATE before reading.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/rendering.py\",\n    \"line\": 79,\n    \"summary\": \"`highlight` puts all quotes into one regex alternation, and regex scanning takes the leftmost match first, not the longest. When two quotes overlap but start at different places, the later one is never marked, yet it is still reported as found.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Body text 'ABCDE' with Review notes quoting 'AB' and 'BCDE'. `finditer` matches 'AB' at position 0 and carries on from position 2, so 'BCDE' gets no &lt;mark&gt;. `found` searches each pattern separately, so it does include 'BCDE', and the preview's '已不在正文中的' list leaves it out. The Author is told the passage is highlighted, but nothing is highlighted. The docstring's claim 'Where quotes overlap, the longest is marked' is wrong in this case.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/guides.py\",\n    \"line\": 450,\n    \"summary\": \"`unpublished_since` counts any Guide Unpublished after the last build, including Guides that were Published after that build and so never reached the Site.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Build at T0. The Admin Publishes Guide 7 at T1, then Unpublishes it at T2, with no build in between. `changes_not_on_site` returns 1 and the dashboard asks for an 更新网站, but the live Site never had Guide 7, so the rebuild changes nothing. To fix this, also require that the Guide's `published_at` (or a 'publish' event) is no later than `since`.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/db.py\",\n    \"line\": 77,\n    \"summary\": \"`review_rounds.guide_id` and `review_notes.round_id` have no indexes, yet `_SELECT` now runs a correlated `EXISTS (... WHERE review_rounds.guide_id = guides.id)` for every row of every Guide query.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Each Guide listing, dashboard load, site build (`published()`) and single-Guide fetch now scans the whole review_rounds table once per Guide, so the cost grows as guides × rounds. `review_rounds()` likewise scans review_notes once per round. Fix: add `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ... ON review_rounds (guide_id)` and `... ON review_notes (round_id)`.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"templates/admin/guide_review.html\",\n    \"line\": 33,\n    \"summary\": \"The 发布 button sits in the same form as the Review note textareas, but the publish route ignores the quote and advice fields, so any notes the Admin typed are thrown away without warning.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"An Admin types three notes, decides to publish anyway, or presses 发布 by mistake instead of 退回给作者. The Guide is Published, nothing is stored and no message appears. If publish is refused, `workflow_step` sends the Admin to the editor page, not back to the review page, so the typed notes are gone there too.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/guides.py\",\n    \"line\": 363,\n    \"summary\": \"`review_rounds` runs one extra query per round to load its notes (an N+1 pattern), and `quotes_to_highlight` loads every round and every note only to use the newest round.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A Guide sent back 10 times costs 11 queries on every editor load and every preview, and the preview discards 9 of the rounds. Cheaper option: one query joining review_notes to review_rounds ordered by (round id DESC, note id), grouped in Python. For the preview, select only the notes of `MAX(review_rounds.id)`.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/guides.py\",\n    \"line\": 394,\n    \"summary\": \"Quotes are checked against a fresh render of the Markdown, and the review page renders the same body again, so one Return renders and parses the Guide body at least four times.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"`_checked_notes` calls render_markdown plus highlight for both body_zh and body_en. If the Return is refused, `review_page` renders both bodies again, and `visible_guide` opens another database connection. A small helper that renders each body once and returns the found set would remove the duplicated parse and sanitize work.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/guides.py\",\n    \"line\": 249,\n    \"summary\": \"`review_step` copies the transaction, flash and redirect structure of `workflow_step` with only small differences, instead of extending the existing helper.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"There are now two near-identical try/with/except/flash/redirect wrappers, and their refusal handling has already drifted apart: one shows the editor page, the other the review page. A future fix to one, such as saving edits together with the step, will miss the other. `workflow_step` could take the step as a partial with the notes already bound, plus an error-page callback.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/guides.py\",\n    \"line\": 216,\n    \"summary\": \"`sent_review_notes` silently drops any row where the quote or advice is not a string (for example a file upload), instead of handing it to the domain layer to refuse.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A crafted multipart post with `quote` sent as a file is filtered out without any message. For Unpublish, where notes are optional, this means the Guide is Unpublished with fewer notes than were sent and no error is shown. This contradicts the docstring's promise that a half-filled row is kept so app/guides.py can refuse it.\"\n  }\n]\n```</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>75120</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>6</tool_uses><duration_ms>120766</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

Tags are copied as they came, so attributes\n    are never touched.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, patterns: dict[str, re.Pattern[str]]) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.patterns = patterns\n        self.out: list[str] = []\n        self.found: set[str] = set()\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        self.out.append(self.get_starttag_text() or \"\")\n\n    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        self.out.append(f\"</{tag}>\")\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        spans: list[tuple[int, int]] = []\n        for quote, pattern in self.patterns.items():\n            matches = [match.span() for match in pattern.finditer(data)]\n            if matches:\n                self.found.add(quote)\n                spans += matches\n        done = 0\n        for start, end in _merged(spans):\n            self.out += [escape(data[done:start], quote=False),\n                         f\"<mark>{escape(data[start:end], quote=False)}</mark>\"]\n            done = end\n        self.out.append(escape(data[done:], quote=False))\n\n\ndef _merged(spans: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:\n    \"\"\"The spans in order, with any that overlap or touch joined into one.\"\"\"\n    merged: list[tuple[int, int]] = []\n    for start, end in sorted(spans):\n        if merged and start <= merged[-1][1]:\n            merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], max(end, merged[-1][1]))\n        else:\n            merged.append((start, end))\n    return merged\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. {"parentUuid":"64eb080c-e2fd-4a09-a003-2d727cb31a4c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8Pw2WDm3wHAJTNcMX26","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MWBoKuyDVzNC4k5f5fy8Zp","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032/scratchpad/review.md <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings for T05 and how each was resolved\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---------|------------|\n| 1 | **Race:** Return/Unpublish read the status, then wrote it in a separate step. Two Admins acting at once could undo each other's step (e.g. a Guide just Published turned back into a Draft). | **Fixed.** `_send_back` now runs `UPDATE … WHERE id = ? AND status = ?` *first*, with the status that was read. If no row changes, the step is refused (\"这篇攻略刚被别人改过…\") and the transaction rolls back before any review round is written. (`publish` has the same read-then-write shape. That is T03 code, so it is out of scope here.) |\n| 2 | **Overlapping quotes:** a single regex alternation marks the leftmost match, so a second quote overlapping it at a different start was reported as found but never highlighted. | **Fixed.** Each quote is matched on its own, and overlapping spans are merged into one `<mark>`. Test: `test_overlapping_quoted_passages_are_both_highlighted`. |\n| 3 | **`unpublished_since` overcounts:** a Guide Published *and* Unpublished after the last build is counted as a pending change. | **Not changed.** The suggested fix (`published_at <= since`) would *undercount* when a Guide is Unpublished, Published again and Unpublished again after a build. The dashboard would then say \"网站已是最新\" while the Guide is still online. Overcounting only asks for an unneeded rebuild, so it is the safer error. |\n| 4 | **No indexes** on `review_rounds.guide_id` / `review_notes.round_id`, but every Guide query runs a correlated `EXISTS`. | **Fixed.** Added both indexes. |\n| 5 | **The 发布 button sat inside the Review-note form**, so notes typed before pressing it were silently thrown away. | **Fixed.** 发布 now has its own form above the Review note builder, which only Returns or Unpublishes. |\n| 6 | **N+1 in `review_rounds`** (one query per round). | **Fixed.** Now one `LEFT JOIN` query, grouped in Python. |\n| 7 | Quotes are rendered and checked several times per Return. | **Not changed.** These are a few Markdown renders of one Guide on an Admin's click, so the cost is negligible. Caching would make the refusal path harder to follow. |\n| 8 | `review_step` duplicates `workflow_step`. | **Not changed.** They differ on purpose. `workflow_step` saves the editor form and shows the editor on refusal. `review_step` carries Review notes and shows the review screen with the notes kept. Merging them would need a callback for each difference. |\n| 9 | `sent_review_notes` silently dropped non-text fields (e.g. a file posted as `quote`), so Unpublish could go ahead with fewer notes than were sent. | **Fixed.** A non-text field counts as blank, so a half-filled row reaches `app/guides.py` and is refused. Test: `test_a_review_note_sent_as_a_file_is_refused_not_dropped`. |\n\nAfter fixes: pyright 0 errors; `pytest` 170 passed.\nEOF\ngh issue comment 6 --body-file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032/scratchpad/review.md"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":377,"cache_read_input_tokens":161097,"output_tokens":1339,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":377,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1339,"cache_read_input_tokens":161097,"cache_creation_input_tokens":377,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":377},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01MWBoKuyDVzNC4k5f5fy8Zp":{"command":"cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032/scratchpad/review.md <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings for T05 and how each was resolved\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---------|------------|\n| 1 | **Race:** Return/Unpublish read the status, then wrote it in a separate step. {"parentUuid":"ac9ce769-e7bf-4cff-b87c-1881b7e3c0ea","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8Px4K9YozgDDrP9h3fs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CnFAA5k4gghNjKcstN18vT","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"git add app/accounts.py app/db.py app/guides.py app/publish.py app/rendering.py app/routes/dashboard.py app/routes/guides.py templates/admin/_review_notes.html templates/admin/base.html templates/admin/dashboard.html templates/admin/guide_edit.html templates/admin/guide_preview.html templates/admin/guide_review.html tests/test_t05_review.py\ngit commit -q -F - <<'EOF'\nT05: Admins Return or Unpublish Guides with Review notes\n\n- Return sends a Submitted Guide back to its Author as a Draft with one or\n  more Review notes (quoted passage + advice). Unpublish does the same for a\n  Published Guide, notes optional. {"parentUuid":"de4e4cd6-fe87-4a76-a4e9-c3b7c51c0aa4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8PxQT7JMBMJh7VgyN7Q","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T05 (#6) is done and committed as `a239178` (`T05: … Closes #6`). The full suite passes (170 tests, 20 of them new in `tests/test_t05_review.py`) and pyright reports 0 errors.\n\n**What it does now**\n- **Return:** Admins get a review screen at `/admin/guides/<id>/review` where they write Review notes, each a quoted passage plus advice. Return needs at least one complete note and turns the Guide back into a Draft.\n- **Unpublish:** turns a Published Guide back into a Draft, with notes optional. The next Site build leaves it out, and the dashboard counts it as a change not yet on the site.\n- **Permissions:** Editors are refused on every review route, even posting directly: 403 on their own Guides, 404 on anyone else's.\n- **Author side:** the dashboard shows a badge with a list of Guides sent back. Review notes from every round, newest first, sit at the top of the Draft's edit page. The preview highlights passages that are still in the text.\n- **Admin side:** the dashboard has a 待审核 queue listing every Submitted Guide.\n- **Public site:** Review notes and highlights never reach it, and a test checks this.\n\n**Choices I made that you may want to change**\n- **Quotes must be found in the body.** A Return or Unpublish is refused if a quoted passage isn't in the Guide's body. Matching ignores whitespace, so Chinese text broken across lines still matches. A quote that runs across formatting, such as part bold and part not, isn't found.\n- **Which passages get highlighted:** only those quoted in the latest round, and none once the Guide is Published again. Otherwise old quotes would stay highlighted forever.\n- **The badge counts both Returned and Unpublished Guides**, and is labelled 被退回或撤下, because both kinds come back to the Author as a Draft.\n- **Stored as review rounds:** each Return or Unpublish is recorded as a review round (two new tables, `review_rounds` and `review_notes`). \"Returned\" is worked out from those rounds, not stored on the Guide. That keeps existing local databases working, since only new tables were added.\n\n**Review**\nI posted the `/code-review` findings and how each was resolved on #6. Of the nine, I fixed six:\n- a race when two Admins act on the same Guide at once\n- overlapping quotes where one wasn't highlighted\n- missing indexes\n- the 发布 button discarding typed notes\n- one database query per review round\n- file uploads in the note fields being silently dropped\n\nI left three alone, with reasons in the comment. The most important: the \"changes not yet on the site\" count can overcount a Guide that was Published and then Unpublished between builds. The suggested fix would undercount in other cases and leave a Guide online, which is the worse error.\n\n**Not done**\n- `publish` (T03 code) has the same check-then-write race that I fixed for Return and Unpublish. I left it out of this ticket.\n- The demo seed has no Returned Guide.\n\nI didn't stage `notes/usage-ledger.csv` or the session-12 transcript, since neither is part of this ticket."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":625,"cache_read_input_tokens":162883,"output_tokens":1111,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":78},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":625,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1111,"cache_read_input_tokens":162883,"cache_creation_input_tokens":625,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":625},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011Cg8PxQ9kCi9Vf3bEXcyB4","requestRef":"18ce1a75-55f5-4c8a-93c0-6791e245662e","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"937ad7bb-e188-4f36-905f-b5d8b34daa7b","timestamp":"2026-10-17T19:55:15.163Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"7a52c3f9-99a9-4b42-911f-db5903bdb032","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

A\n    span of whitespace only is left unmarked: it may sit between block\n    elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n    out, done = [], 0\n    for start, end in spans:\n        out.append(escape(text[done:start], quote=False))\n        piece = escape(text[start:end], quote=False)\n        out.append(f\"<mark>{piece}</mark>\" if piece.strip() else piece)\n        done = end\n    out.append(escape(text[done:], quote=False))\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. A quote is matched against\n    the text as Readers see it, ignoring whitespace and formatting, so a\n    passage copied from the preview is found even if it is part bold or runs\n    through a link. Its <mark> is then split at the tags it crosses. Quotes\n    that overlap are marked together.\"\"\"\n    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n {"parentUuid":"ee14a06c-b752-44e9-bbd7-6b473b4b4b81","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8SV6cQfrG9WPxjKaDto","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've made both changes and committed them as `a4d3665`. All 173 tests pass, including three new ones (one per behaviour below), and pyright reports 0 errors.\n\n**1. Quotes now match across formatting.** `highlight` in `app/rendering.py` searches the text as Readers see it, ignoring tags and whitespace. A passage copied from the preview is now found and highlighted even when it is part bold, runs through a link, or spans list items or paragraphs. The highlight is split at each tag the quote crosses. For example, `别忘了买**锚**` with the quote `别忘了买锚` becomes `<mark>别忘了买</mark><strong><mark>锚</mark></strong>`. Line breaks between paragraphs or list items are left unmarked, and the original tags and attributes are copied through unchanged. The error message no longer tells Admins to avoid copying across formatting.\n\n**2. Every round is highlighted.** The preview now highlights passages quoted in every review round, as long as they are still in the text. Quotes that appear in more than one round are only listed once. The help text on the edit page and the preview now says so, and the preview still lists any quotes that are no longer in the text.\n\n**Decision for you:** I kept one existing rule. Once a Guide is Published again, its preview shows no highlights, because by then the notes have been dealt with. The strongest wins.\n_PLAIN, _EARLIER, _LATEST = 0, 1, 2\n_MARKS = {_EARLIER: '<mark class=\"earlier\">', _LATEST: \"<mark>\"}\n\n\ndef _marked(text: str, levels: bytearray) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text`, escaped, with each run of highlighted characters (one level\n    per character) in its <mark>. A run of whitespace only is left unmarked:\n    it may sit between block elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n    out, done = [], 0\n    for level, run in groupby(levels):\n        end = done + len(list(run))\n        piece = escape(text[done:end], quote=False)\n        out.append(f\"{_MARKS[level]}{piece}</mark>\" if level and piece.strip()\n                   else piece)\n        done = end\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str],\n              earlier: Iterable[str] = ()) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` (the latest review round's) and `earlier` (those\n    of rounds before it) where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. unknown --session-id \"$_SESSION_ID\" 2>/dev/null || true\n    fi\n    rm -f \"$_PF\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  fi\n  break\ndone\neval \"$(~/.claude/skills/gstack/bin/gstack-slug 2>/dev/null)\" 2>/dev/null || true\n_LEARN_FILE=\"${GSTACK_HOME:-$HOME/.gstack}/projects/${SLUG:-unknown}/learnings.jsonl\"\nif [ -f \"$_LEARN_FILE\" ]; then\n  _LEARN_COUNT=$(wc -l < \"$_LEARN_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')\n  echo \"LEARNINGS: $_LEARN_COUNT entries loaded\"\n  if [ \"$_LEARN_COUNT\" -gt 5 ] 2>/dev/null; then\n    ~/.claude/skills/gstack/bin/gstack-learnings-search --limit 3 2>/dev/null || true\n  fi\nelse\n  echo \"LEARNINGS: 0\"\nfi\n~/.claude/skills/gstack/bin/gstack-timeline-log CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null; then\n  _HAS_ROUTING=\"yes\"\nfi\n_ROUTING_DECLINED=$(~/.claude/skills/gstack/bin/gstack-config get routing_declined 2>/dev/null || echo \"false\")\necho \"HAS_ROUTING:
